title: Veeam Backup Report Automation
tagline: Power Automate workflow that turns Veeam emails into usable Excel reporting.
description: I created a Power Automate flow that turns Veeam emails into Excel reports. It extracts backup results, calculates success rates and prevents duplicates.
features: Automatic trigger when an Outlook email with "Backup" in the subject is received.
Conversion of the HTML body to plain text to make notifications easier to parse.
Automatic extraction of the job name, total VMs, successes, errors and warnings.
Success rate computed from the extracted metrics.
Duplicate check on date and job name before anything is added to Excel.
Results inserted into an Excel Online table dedicated to backup tracking.
challenges: I had to handle different email formats and retry notifications. I cleaned the data and checked the date and job name before each insertion.
learnings: I learned to make a low-code workflow more reliable, from data extraction to duplicate checks.
